claim: Observability exposes live metrics for self-assessment.
Orchestration plans can be created and verified rapidly.
A minimal proof loop must include plan, execute, verify, record, and message to be complete.
Evidence should be captured as durable atoms with tags for auditing.
Status messages belong in a shared thread to ensure team coordination.
Meta-circular validation enables systems to validate themselves using their own tools.
Quartet parity (docs, code, tests, evidence) must be maintained at all scales.
Proof loops enable continuous validation and system health monitoring.
CMC bitemporal storage enables historical accuracy and current truth queries.
APOE plan orchestration enables executable contracts with gates attached.
